texts: Mire-essence stains a Keeper's coat over time.
A first-year apprentice wears an unstained coat.

q2_gaps: relational kind-generic vs distributing rule when the OBJECT is adjectivally restricted: the stated trigger is "both arguments being bare kind-denoting NPs" (which would give the kind relation (Wear keeper oilcloth_coat)), and only an adjectivally-restricted SUBJECT is stated to force the rule route, so the restricted-object case ("long" has no slot in a kind relation) is unaddressed

a descriptively-modified bare-plural object inside a generic rule: nothing says whether it is the bare kind filler ("grows wheat"), a per-binding Skolem group (as the numbered "every student read three books" uses), or, as here, a single per-binding Skolem witness, so the object's plurality is silently dropped
review.notes: The distributing-rule route is defensible as the only one that carries "long" (a stated restriction is never silently dropped), and the 0.9/0.9 bare generic, Agent/Theme roles, oilcloth_coat fusion with genus only, and separate Member long atom are all correct. Sentence-initial "Keepers" supplies no casing evidence of name-hood, so the common-noun kind reading is right.

Definite plural takes a group witness with both the group event and the per-member distribution rule as the distributive-predicate rule requires; "against" is the licensed preposition-named oblique for the prepositional verb, and "sea-spray" decomposes to its genus while staying a bare mass constant.

fields.sentence: Mire-essence stains a Keeper's coat over time.

q1_issues.issue: The clause is a verbal generic over a bare mass kind (simple present plus 'over time'), which the instruction set routes to a distributing Implication rule with a Skolem-function event — the kind-relation route being barred because the object 'a Keeper's coat' is an indefinite singular — but the parse emits a flat episodic event bundle instead.

The bare kind symbol mire_essence fills the individual Agent slot of a minted event witness, a position the set licenses for bare class symbols only as non-specific/generic objects, not as the subject of a generic clause that should have become a rule range.

q2_gaps: gradual-process adverbial 'over time' (and 'gradually', 'in the end'): no licensed carrier — Duration takes a vague-extent surface adverb, Measure ... duration needs a stated figure and unit, and WithinLast is a backward-looking window, so the qualifier is dropped
review.notes: The mire_essence decomposition (genus only, noun modifier unexposed), the Possession head for "a Keeper's coat", the Patient for a substance-applying verb, and treating the capitalized 'a Keeper' as a common noun with a witness are all correct.

issues.reason: A non-modal verbal generic over a kind "becomes a rule that gives each instance its own event, via a Skolem-function event term", and the indefinite-singular object does bar the kind-relation route, so the flat bundle is the wrong shape — and it existentially asserts a particular coat, a particular keeper and a particular staining that a generic never posits.

The generic machinery puts the kind in the rule's premise range, and the one bare-class-symbol slot the set licenses is a non-specific / generic object ("pays tax", "grows wheat"), so (Agent sk_stain_1 mire_essence) seats a kind — the very symbol carrying the kind-level genus (Inheritance mire_essence essence) — in an individual role position.

gaps_confirmed: gradual-process / open-frame adverbial "over time" (and "gradually") has no licensed carrier: Duration takes a vague-extent surface adverb, (Measure e duration n u) needs a stated figure and unit, and WithinLast is a backward-looking window
adjudication.defect_summary: Compliant form is the distributing rule (Implication (Member $x mire_essence) (And (Member (sk_stain $x) stain) (Agent (sk_stain $x) $x) (Patient (sk_stain $x) (sk_coat $x)) (Member (sk_coat $x) coat) (Possession (sk_coat $x) (sk_keeper $x)) (Member (sk_keeper $x) keeper))) at (STV 0.9 0.9), the dependent coat and keeper as per-binding Skolem functions, with only the definitional (Inheritance mire_essence essence) left at top level; the kind symbol then appears as the premise range and never as an Agent filler.
adjudication.notes: Leaving "over time" out rather than mis-slotting it is exactly what the instruction set prescribes for an unrepresentable adverbial. The Possession head for "a Keeper's coat", the Patient role for a substance-applying verb, and the unexposed noun modifier in mire_essence are all correct.

fields.sentence: A first-year apprentice wears an unstained coat.

review.notes: Compound kind correctly fused with the head genus only ('first-year' fails the predication test, so no modifier genus), 'unstained' kept as a positive participial adjective at strength 1.0 and not fused into a compound (incidental description), and the indefinite subject of a verbal clause correctly a witness rather than a generic rule.
